verdict.rationale: Ollama documents a REST API, OpenAI and Anthropic compatibility layers, and Python/JS libraries, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows API versioning or a published deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Having an API is adjacent to this story but does not deliver it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
